description:
Sketchpad is the fastest way to get an idea out of your head and onto the screen. Pick a tool, pick a colour and draw — strokes are smoothed as you go so every line looks confident, even with a mouse.

Switch between an inky Brush, a see-through Marker that layers like the real thing, and a precise Eraser. Mix any colour you like with the built-in colour mixer, and never worry about mistakes: Sketchpad keeps a deep undo and redo history.

When you're done, tap Save to export a crisp, full-resolution PNG. Your drawing is also kept safe between launches, so you can pick up right where you left off.
whatsNew: New colour mixer with hue and brightness control, smoother strokes, and your canvas is now restored when you come back.
